expectations.text: Output is a single self-contained HTML file with no external <script>/<link> resources
The page shows a verdict-first line directly under the title, before any tables
The process table is searchable via an input that filters rows
The process table columns are sortable by clicking headers
There is a checkable action checklist with a copy-to-markdown button
Evidence/details sections are collapsed or loaded on demand, not all expanded at once
A provenance footer records source and generation info
